items.title: An open-source tool lets you delete 12GB of Apple Intelligence data on macOS
items.summary: Getting some extra storage space on your Mac could be as easy as deleting Apple's AI features with a new open-source command line tool called RemoveMacAI.
items.whyItMatters: A tool you could evaluate without a procurement process — the question is whether it removes a task you currently do by hand.
actions: Free to run, but budget the setup time honestly before committing.
